model: fixed data contract, flexible conversation — ask only what can't be inferred; confirm inferences, never assume; visitor corrections always win

questions.copy: What do you need help solving today?

chips.label: How can I track my brand's health?
How do AI models describe my brand?
How do I stack up against my competitors?

questions.notes: Free text can carry multiple domains at once — that is how multi-product opportunities surface.
questions.skipWhen: entry came from a product ad (product_interest pre-filled; opener names the product)

questions.copy: Got it. What's your company? A website works — I'll start pulling your snapshot together.
questions.sideEffect: starts background research (size, industry, competitors, AI-search presence) and the snapshot build — from a website, or from a bare company name
questions.skipWhen: the visitor's first message included a website (the landing's single prompt box invites it)

confirmMode.when: research recognised the company and knows its headcount — copyNoIndustry renders when the model gave no industry
confirmMode.copy: Looks like {company} is around {employees} people, in {industry} — did I get that right?
confirmMode.copyNoIndustry: Looks like {company} is around {employees} people — did I get that right?

askMode.copy: Roughly how big is the company?

questions.copy: When do you want this working — this quarter, this year, or just exploring?
questions.copyWithGoal: So you want to {goal} — when do you want that working: this quarter, this year, or just exploring?

questions.skipWhen: the solution match is already obvious from prior answers

brand_health.copy: How do you track your brand today — an agency, in-house dashboards, or not really yet?
brand_health.decides: always-on tracking subscription vs. deeper analytics; upgrade path

competitive.copy: Who are you measuring against — competitors you name, or the whole category?
competitive.copyWithPeers: I'm seeing {competitors} as your closest comparison set — is that who you're measuring against?
competitive.peersNote: the {competitors} form is only ever asked when research came back with the visitor's REAL comparison set — never with the seeded fallback names (machine/flow.js q6View)

research.copy: Is this a one-off study, or something you'll run regularly?
research.decides: self-service platform vs. serviced research; trial-readiness

business_impact.copy: Who needs convincing — the board, the CFO, or your own team?
business_impact.decides: seniority of the sale; executive audience biases consultative

audiences.copy: Where does your first-party data live — a CDP, a data warehouse, or mostly in the ad platforms?
audiences.decides: data readiness; demo now vs. consultative scoping

influencer.copy: Roughly how many creators do you work with in a year?
influencer.decides: SMB platform vs. enterprise program (~100+ creators)

reputation.copy: Are you watching one market, or monitoring globally in multiple languages?
reputation.decides: early-warning narrative intelligence vs. global media monitoring

ai_visibility.copy: Which platforms matter most to you — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity?

marketing_ops.copy: Which part of the workflow feels most fragmented — planning, creation, media, or measurement?

captureMoment.when: at the snapshot reveal — never before
captureMoment.emailCopy: Get the full report — and keep it updated.
captureMoment.consentCheckbox: It's OK to contact me about these results
